gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-biz-udmincho: Chunky, unshaded letters with bowls left open on one side lead here, and BIZ UDMincho follows with a classic serif's thin, bookish grace. One shouts, one murmurs.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-copse: Copse brings a literary, classic serif voice, with light showing through every curve it draws. Comic Relief joins it with bold, hairline-free letters that hold up even when shrunk down.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cutive: Commanding letters from Comic Relief keep one line width around every turn, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Cutive follows with wide-tracked, refined serif text, and it would get lost if the heading were shrunk small.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-david-libre: David Libre is dignified and refined, its terminals hanging open, while Comic Relief up top is bold and blunt with horizontals as heavy as verticals. David Libre is the one to trust for the steadier, finer text below.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-enriqueta: Enriqueta reads as a literary, dignified classic serif, its chalky curves stopping well short of closing around each bowl. Comic Relief's pencil-like lines never thicken or thin, so the text feels gentler by comparison.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-fenix: Fenix reads like a classic serif with editorial polish, its curved strokes ending before they turn inward. Comic Relief sits above with bold, nib-drawn letters that stay uniform, so the text beneath feels finer by comparison.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-gentium-plus: Gentium Plus is classic and refined, each c opening like a wide-mouthed pitcher. Comic Relief earns its place when set big and short, where its bold, steady curves with no shift in weight can really hold the eye.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-habibi: Habibi is a traditional, editorial text serif with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Comic Relief, meanwhile, glows like neon tubing at one line thickness, best loud and large, while Habibi does its best work in quieter, sustained reading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-inika: Classic and traditional, Inika is the quiet half here, with a see-through gap in each s. Comic Relief is best at bold, round letters with walls as heavy as straight ones, whereas Inika handles the finer text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kay-pho-du: Traditional and classic, Kay Pho Du is a text serif whose counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Comic Relief's bold, commanding letters sit above it, and a long page below would feel unhurried and rolling-ball-pen smooth.
